description: Interop/ingress-wire L1 record for an inbound ISO 20022 payment message (pacs.008 / pain.001 / camt.053 / camt.054) crossing a kawase-yui corridor, per the kotoba_iso20022 cleanroom codec. Materializes one external bank value-event as an append-only, content-addressed kotoba record so a real-world transfer becomes auditable history. NOT an on-chain pool deposit (com.etzhayyim.kawase.depositAttestation is that): when an external transfer corresponds to a kawase on-ramp the two are linked by `linkedDepositCid` for reconciliation. The Adherent SBT remains the KYC (kawase-yui G10); this record is format datafication only and never carries Travel-Rule passport identity. Party names are 要配慮 PII and SHOULD be omitted or routed to a com.etzhayyim.encrypted.envelope; only institution BICs (ISO 9362) are first-class here.

messageDefinition.description: ISO 20022 message definition id this record was sourced from, e.g. 'pacs.008.001.08'.

endToEndId.description: PmtId/EndToEndId — the end-to-end reference that links ingress, status, and reconciliation.

uetr.description: Optional. PmtId/UETR (lowercase UUIDv4 per CBPR+); unchanged across the whole payment chain when present.

txEntity.description: Content-addressed kotoba entity handle for this transaction (com.etzhayyim.iso20022/tx:<UETR|TxId|EndToEndId>). Idempotent: re-ingest maps to the same entity; a later camt/pacs.002 lands on it.

amount.description: Settlement amount as exact decimal text (e.g. '1000.00'). Stored as a string, never a float, to preserve ISO 20022 ActiveCurrencyAndAmount precision.

currency.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic currency code of the amount.

creditDebit.description: Optional. CdtDbtInd for camt entries (CRDT = credit to the account, DBIT = debit).

debtorName.description: Optional + discouraged. Dbtr/Nm is 要配慮 PII; prefer omission or a com.etzhayyim.encrypted.envelope CID. Present only with consent.

creditorName.description: Optional + discouraged. Cdtr/Nm is 要配慮 PII; prefer omission or a com.etzhayyim.encrypted.envelope CID. Present only with consent.

reportedBy.description: Message definition family that reported this value-event (e.g. 'pacs.008', 'camt.054'). Distinguishes the interbank instruction from a later statement/notification of the same transaction.

status.description: Optional. Latest known transaction status (pacs.002 TxSts such as ACSC/RJCT, or camt entry Sts such as BOOK/PDNG).

cbprConformant.description: Optional. Whether the source message passed kotoba_iso20022 CBPR+ Usage-Guideline conformance at ingest time.

linkedDepositCid.description: Optional. CID of a com.etzhayyim.kawase.depositAttestation this external transfer reconciles against (on-ramp/off-ramp loop-close). Absent when the transfer has no kawase counterpart.

datomCount.description: Optional. Number of append-only EAVT Datoms emitted for this message by to_datoms() at ingest.

ingestedAt.description: When the message was datafied into kotoba (NOT the bank's value/booking date, which live on the entity facts).
